claims.statement: Stripe documents that a formal dispute immediately reverses the payment and debits the transaction amount plus a dispute fee, yielding an observable loss event.
The merchant is the proposed payer because its balance and operations absorb the dispute, but willingness to buy an independent cross-PSP tool is unverified.
A merchant can contractually authorize a provider to collect evidence and prepare submissions; PSP-specific API permissions and merchant approval must be verified before any automated submission.
Stripe already advertises automated evidence collection for eligible disputes, which is evidence of both technical feasibility and direct incumbent pressure.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Finance, payments, fraud, or e-commerce operations lead
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: The product must win on multi-PSP evidence reuse, transparent case economics, and outcome portability rather than generic automation
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns its direct merchant contract
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Merchant outbound, agency referrals, app listings where permitted, and accountant or fractional-CFO channels

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Performance-based pilot plus agency referrals; target recovery after 20-40 processed disputes, unvalidated
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Per-case fees billed monthly; recovery share collected only after PSP resolution
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 60-80% after review labor; case heterogeneity may reduce it
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Connector onboarding, exception handling, evidence approval support, and rule updates
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security testing, GDPR contracts, cyber insurance, card-data scope controls, and legal review
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 60-180 PLN per submitted case plus 5-10% of recovered amount, or a monthly volume plan
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Model/API use, document storage, PSP calls, payment processing, and human quality review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: PSPs already provide guided evidence tools and some offer automated dispute products inside their platforms
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A dispute immediately reverses the transaction amount and can add a dispute fee; recovery or loss is measured at case resolution
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Rising dispute volume, a missed evidence deadline, or staff time spent collecting proof across systems
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each submitted dispute and monthly platform continuation

contrary_evidence: Stripe already offers Smart Disputes and guided evidence, reducing value for single-PSP merchants.
The issuer, not the evidence tool, decides outcomes; stronger packets cannot guarantee recovery.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Nonexclusive 12-month workflow-integration and data-processing agreement with revocable scoped credentials
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Offer secure manual upload and support alternative PSPs; never use merchant data without authorization
critical_control_point.current_owner: Merchant controls business evidence; PSP and card network control the dispute interface and decision
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Founder company owns its direct merchant contract
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: The path uses ordinary merchant contracts, scoped API credentials, and processor terms available to any qualified vendor; no privileged employer or family data is required.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Founder company after a merchant signs a processing agreement and grants scoped API or export access
critical_control_point.renewal: Monthly service renewal under an annual data-processing framework
critical_control_point.subject: Authorized evidence-assembly and submission checkpoint for each merchant dispute

economics.acquisition_route: Outcome-tracked pilots, e-commerce agencies, fractional CFOs, and permitted app ecosystems
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: 250000 annual cases at 70 PLN blended net revenue imply 17.5m PLN revenue; a 5m PLN founder outcome requires multi-PSP distribution, strong contribution margins, and retained merchant contracts
economics.founder_time: Four to five hours daily for product and scheduled reviews; customer approval and support need asynchronous design
economics.gross_margin_basis: Automated evidence joins and templating with human review only before high-value or ambiguous submissions
economics.payback: Target CAC recovery after 20-40 paid cases; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 60-180 PLN per submitted dispute plus 5-10% of recovered value or a volume subscription
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repeat follows ongoing dispute volume and demonstrable net recovery versus native PSP tools

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned outcome labels by reason code, evidence mix, vertical, and PSP improve packet prioritization
fingerprint.customer: EU online merchants using more than one payment service provider or storefront
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Direct outreach to merchants and nonexclusive integrations or referral agreements with e-commerce agencies and accounting firms
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Reason-code-specific evidence assembly, human approval, submission routing, and outcome tracking priced per case or recovery
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Merchant pays when a dispute packet is submitted, with an optional percentage of recovered funds
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A cardholder dispute reverses a payment and starts an evidence deadline while relevant proof is split across systems

founder_fit: Classification, document extraction, and outcome learning match data-science strengths
Case value, recovery, handling time, and deadline compliance are measurable
The workflow can be automated and scheduled around full-time employment
Finance interest aligns with payment-loss analysis without requiring on-camera distribution
risks: Handling payment and identity evidence creates security and privacy exposure
A bad submission may consume the merchant's only evidence round
PSP terms may restrict automation or third-party access

structure.commercial_archetype: Usage-priced dispute operations software with optional recovery fee
structure.control_point: Merchant-authorized workflow integration between dispute notice and evidence submission
structure.critical_dependency: Stable PSP and commerce-platform integrations plus merchant approval before submission

thesis: Obtain merchant-authorized access to the dispute, order, delivery, refund, and communication workflow, then charge per submitted evidence packet and share in recoveries across payment providers.
title: Cross-PSP Chargeback Evidence Router
uncertainties: Recoverable dispute volume among Polish and EU mid-market merchants
API coverage for evidence submission across PSPs
Incremental win-rate improvement over native tools
Merchant tolerance for a recovery share in addition to PSP fees
